note: PRE-START. These are the SPEC's expected values, not a bake. While baked is false, every real visitor sees the control card and nothing is sent to the platform; only a bolt_qa browser with ?bolt_xp=<variation> sees an arm (configVersion 1 is a placeholder for those QA links). After the owner Starts the experiment, run: node tools/xp/bake.mjs (it fetches the public config, saves tools/xp/public-config-snapshot.json, and rewrites this file with baked true), then node tools/quick-landing-build.mjs.
